messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Propose ONE conjecture in response.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "A configuration of 13 points in the unit square exists achieving a minimum triangle area of exactly 1/108, constructed by placing three points on each of the four sides of the square at positions (0, 1/6), (0, 1/2), (0, 5/6), (1, 1/6), (1, 1/2), (1, 5/6), (1/6, 0), (5/6, 0), (1/6, 1), (5/6, 1), and two interior points at (1/3, 1/3) and (2/3, 2/3). This is the optimal value because 1/108 is an upper bound on the minimum triangle area for any 13-point configuration, and the described symmetric placement attains this bound by ensuring every collinear triple is separated by minimum distance 1/3 and every non-collinear triple spans at least the area of a triangle with height 1/6 and base 1/3."}
